title: Most Eligible Bachelor
desc: Harsha, a successful expat, is willing to marry any woman his parents choose for him. However, he eventually falls for Vibha, an outspoken lady, who challenges his views on marriage.

title: Marina
desc: Ambikathy, an orphan, leaves his cruel uncle and ends up at Marina Beach, where he sells food to save money for night school, determined to pursue his dream of getting an education.

title: Paranthu Po
desc: A struggling father and his stubborn son take on a road trip to escape the pressures of their daily lives and along the way discover the valuable things missing from their lives.

title: Annabelle Sethupathi
desc: Rudra, a petty burglar, stumbles upon an uninhabited castle. However, when she learns of the tragedy marring its history, she vows to free the residents trapped against their will.

title: Annanukku Jey
desc: A toddy seller's son becomes a politician and overcomes multiple challenges in order to take revenge from the bar owner, who mistreated his father.

title: Ruler
desc: A businesswoman adopts a stranger who saves her life and raises him as her son. However, the young man has a dark past that catches up with him despite his mother's attempts to shield him from it.

title: Bhoomi
desc: Bhoominathan, a NASA scientist, helps his village people against the evil corporations.

title: Sadugudu Vandi
desc: Shiva, struggling to find a decent job, finally takes up the job of a cab driver. However, things take an eerie and spooky turn when mysterious deaths start happening in the cab.

title: Mantra 2
desc: Mantra, an orphan, lives happily as a paying guest with an old couple. When some thieves break into the house and attempt to kill her, she learns an eerie truth about the family she is staying with.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Unnaiththane
desc: A Christian Zumba instructor and a Hindu upper-caste woman bond over dance and fall in love. But their relationship faces struggles as they face discrimination due to their caste.

title: Kathanayagan
desc: A revenue inspector falls in love with a girl but faces problems due to his cowardliness. He is compelled to find a way to prove himself to her father, who wants her to marry a brave man.

title: Nenjamellam Pala Vannam
desc: Two unemployed brothers who do not get along well due to their contrasting natures try to marry the women they love before an accident changes their lives.

title: Velainu Vandhutta Vellaikaaran
desc: A minister on his deathbed reveals to an MLA the whereabouts of billions in cash that he has stashed away. However, the minister's relatives are vexed when the MLA loses his memory in an accident.

title: Mannarkudi Veeran
desc: Siddhartha, a courageous District Commissioner, goes against a notorious local politician.

title: Oru Nodi
desc: When a man goes missing under perplexing circumstances, a police inspector embarks on a quest to investigate the case, exposing a concealed network of political corruption.

title: King of Kotha
desc: Heartbroken on being back-stabbed by his childhood friend, Raju, an influential man, runs away from his hometown, Kotha. Soon, to bring back order in the town, a police officer plots a plan.
